name: tech-selection
description: >- Gated checklist for choosing between technologies: library, framework, storage, data format, model, build-vs-buy, architecture. Runs before committing, not after. Candidates must clear a business-result anchor, prior-art inventory, an observed-behavior probe, and the maintenance, boring-tech, data-structure, operator-skill gates; READMEs are not evidence. Filters violators rather than ranking options: when two or more survive, STOP and return candidates plus trade-offs plus a recommendation,
author: daymade
